description: This file provides support for __torch_function__ tensor subclasses within TorchDynamo, including classes and functions to handle tensor subclass dispatch, mode management, and attribute handling.

classes.name: TorchFunctionModeVariable
classes.description: Represents a torch function mode, supporting context management and dispatching.

classes.name: TorchFunctionModeStackStateManager
classes.description: Manages temporary stack states for torch function modes.

classes.name: SymbolicTorchFunctionState
classes.description: Tracks the state of torch function modes and subclasses during symbolic execution.

classes.name: TorchFunctionModeStackVariable
classes.description: Dummy variable indicating mutation of torch function mode stack.

classes.name: TensorWithTFOverrideVariable
classes.description: Represents tensor subclasses with __torch_function__ overrides, handling attribute access and method calls.

methods.name: get_prev_stack_var_name
methods.description: Returns a unique variable name for previous torch function mode stack.

methods.name: is_supported_torch_function_mode
methods.description: Checks if a torch function mode supports graph breaks.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a TorchFunctionModeVariable with optional source.

methods.name: reconstruct
methods.description: Reconstructs the source code for the mode variable.

methods.name: module_name
methods.description: Returns the module name of the torch function mode.

methods.name: fn_name
methods.description: Returns the class name of the torch function mode.

methods.name: python_type
methods.description: Returns the type of the torch function mode.

methods.name: call_torch_function
methods.description: Dispatches a call to __torch_function__ with given arguments.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Enters the torch function mode context, pushing onto the stack.

methods.name: exit
methods.description: Exits the torch function mode context, popping from the stack.

methods.name: reconstruct_type
methods.description: Reconstructs the type of the mode in codegen.

methods.name: supports_graph_breaks
methods.description: Indicates if the mode supports graph breaks.

methods.name: exit_on_graph_break
methods.description: Indicates if the mode should exit on graph break.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the torch function mode stack offset.

methods.name: register_mutation
methods.description: Registers a mutation to the torch function mode stack.

methods.name: register_device_context_insertion
methods.description: Inserts a device context into the mode stack.

methods.name: clear_default_device
methods.description: Removes a device context from the mode stack.

methods.name: is_device_context
methods.description: Checks if a variable is a device context.

methods.name: get_mode_index
methods.description: Calculates the index of a mode considering the offset.

methods.name: _get_all_args
methods.description: Flattens args and kwargs into VariableTracker list.

methods.name: _flatten_vts
methods.description: Recursively flattens VariableTracker objects.

methods.name: _get_subclass_type
methods.description: Gets the class type of a tensor subclass variable.

methods.name: _get_subclass_type_var
methods.description: Gets a VariableTracker for the subclass type.

methods.name: _is_attr_overridden
methods.description: Checks if an attribute is overridden in a tensor subclass.

methods.name: call_torch_function
methods.description: Emulates calling __torch_function__ with proper arguments.

methods.name: get_torch_function_fn
methods.description: Retrieves the __torch_function__ method as a VariableTracker.

methods.name: can_dispatch_torch_function
methods.description: Determines if torch function dispatch is possible based on overrides.

methods.name: dispatch_torch_function
methods.description: Dispatches a torch function call to the appropriate override.
